verses.text: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he continually multiplieth lies and desolation; and they make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

segments.text: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he continually multiplieth lies and desolation; and they make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

verses.text: Jehovah hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

segments.text: Jehovah hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

verses.text: In the womb he took his brother by the heel; and in his manhood he had power with God:

segments.text: In the womb he took his brother by the heel; and in his manhood he had power with God:

verses.text: yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him at Beth-el, and there he spake with us,

segments.text: yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him at Beth-el, and there he spake with us,

verses.text: even Jehovah, the God of hosts; Jehovah is his memorial name.

segments.text: even Jehovah, the God of hosts; Jehovah is his memorial

verses.text: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep kindness and justice, and wait for thy God continually.

segments.text: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep kindness and justice, and wait for thy God continually.

verses.text: He is a trafficker, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.

segments.text: a trafficker, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.

verses.text: And Ephraim said, Surely I am become rich, I have found me wealth: in all my labors they shall find in me no iniquity that were sin.

segments.text: And Ephraim said, Surely I am become rich, I have found me wealth: in all my labors they shall find in me no iniquity that were sin.

verses.text: But I am Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt; I will yet again make thee to dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

segments.text: But I am Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt; I will yet again make thee to dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

verses.text: I have also spoken unto the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets have I used similitudes.

segments.text: I have also spoken unto the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets have I used similitudes.

verses.text: Is Gilead iniquity? they are altogether false; in Gilgal they sacrifice bullocks; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the field.

segments.text: Is Gilead iniquity? they are altogether false; in Gilgal they sacrifice bullocks; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the field.

verses.text: And Jacob fled into the field of Aram, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.

segments.text: And Jacob fled into the field of Aram, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept

verses.text: And by a prophet Jehovah brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

segments.text: And by a prophet Jehovah brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

verses.text: Ephraim hath provoked to anger most bitterly: therefore shall his blood be left upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
